parsed.post: Huge jump! DEPTH=8 achieved val_bpb 0.851284. Even though it reduces optimizer steps, the increased capacity is clearly providing a stronger signal. I'll continue exploring capacity by looking at the ASPECT_RATIO or perhaps slightly adjusting the LR to accommodate the deeper architecture.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 128 with DEPTH 8 to further increase model capacity and see if the gain from depth continues to scale.
